briefdescription.para: Engine-side immutable monomial value type wrapping a varpower- encoded exponent vector.

detaileddescription.para: Storage is [2n+1, v_1, e_1, ..., v_n, e_n] (per ExponentList.hpp): leading length, then alternating variable indices and exponents. Inherits from EngineObject so the monomial can carry a stable content-based hash once exposed to the front end. The TODO at the top of the file notes a planned template-based unification with the lower-level varpower routines.
